subject: Medford Family Network Overview and Funding Loss
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway about the history, services, and community partnerships of the Medford Family Network. The guests outlined MFN's free family support programming and discussed strategies to address an upcoming grant loss that cuts half their budget.

items.title: Introduction and Guest Welcome
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced the episode of Medford Happenings and welcomed guests Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway from the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Guest Backgrounds
items.summary: Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway shared their background experience in early childhood education and social work.

items.title: Founding and History of Medford Family Network
items.summary: Cassidy described founding MFN through a state grant in 1993, and Shumway explained her path from a parent participant to a staff member.

items.title: Overview of Network Services
items.summary: Shumway and Cassidy detailed MFN's free services for local families with children up to age eight, including playgroups, parent education classes, home visits, and essential material goods.

items.title: Organizational Successes and Major Funding Loss
items.summary: Cassidy announced that MFN will lose a primary grant representing half of its annual operating budget as of July 1st.

items.title: Fundraising and Volunteer Opportunities
items.summary: The guests described the role of the Friends of the Medford Family Network board and invited community members to assist through monetary donations, material supplies, or volunteering.

items.title: Community Partnerships
items.summary: Cassidy outlined MFN's collaborations with city agencies, local schools, housing shelters, and community groups.

items.title: Upcoming Events and 33rd Anniversary
items.summary: Guests previewed upcoming summer events celebrating MFN's 33rd anniversary, including a dance-a-thon, teddy bear picnic, and concert series.
